compliance.status: compliant via RDP (3rd round carry-forward = 46) plus 4th round unmet need overlay zones and mandatory set-aside ordinance
compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center (FSHC) and New Jersey Builders Association

notes: Wyckoff Township: DCA Present Need = 40; DCA Prospective Need = 387. Township initially committed to PN=40 and 4th round PN=277 (January 21/29, 2025 resolution). FSHC and NJ Builders Association objected. Mediation Agreement with FSHC executed March 24, 2025 set PN=40, 4th round = 344. Court Order (May 30, 2025, Hon. Lina P. Corriston, J.S.C.) fixed at 40/334. DCA figure of 387 is higher; plan and court use 334. No additional 4th round RDP — RDP = 46 (3rd round carry-forward: partially generated by developed/partially-developed parcels via 2018 settlement). Unmet need = 334 (the entire 4th round obligation). 4th round unmet need strategies provide realistic zoning for 93 affordable units, exceeding the 25%-of-334 = 84 unit threshold required by the Amended FHA. Rehab obligation (40) addressed via Bergen County Housing Improvement Program (CDBG). Third round obligation = 640 (set by 2018 FSHC settlement). Prior round (1st & 2nd round) obligation = 221, fully satisfied. RDP sites: Block 259 Lots 1,2 (3 affordable rental at 12 du/ac); Turtle Creek Condo extensions (2 credits, affordability control extension); Block 216 Lots 17.01/18/19 Greenwood Ave (1 affordable rental at 12 du/ac); Block 216 Lots 13.08/13.09/13.10 (2-3 affordable rental at 12 du/ac mixed use); ECCR Group Home 832 Mountain Ave (5-bedroom group home, 5 credits); United Way/Madeline Block 238 Lot 2/370 Clinton Ave (6-bedroom group home, 6 credits, constructed); Maple Lake/Sarna Block 320 Lots 10.02/11 (9 affordable family rental of 60 total, 10 credits with bonus, zoned); CHCC Evergreen Court (6 of 24 senior rental units counted toward RDP). 4th round unmet need: Squaw Brook Church Block 437 Lots 18/19/20.02 (3 du/ac, 20% set-aside); 168/174 Franklin Ave (4.5 du/ac, 20% set-aside); B-1 District Godwin & Franklin (7.2 ac, 10 du/ac, 20% set-aside); B-2 District Godwin & Crescent (4.64 ac, 10 du/ac, 20% set-aside); 825 Wyndham Court Block 203 Lot 3.04 (4.0 ac, 10 du/ac, 20% set-aside); 139 Franklin Ave Block 208 Lots 76/77 (6.55 ac, 8 du/ac, 20% set-aside); Goffle Road Expanded Area (4.27 ac, 10 du/ac, 20% set-aside); 500 West Main Block 222 Lot 1.01 (13.7 ac, 10 du/ac, 20% set-aside); 475 Lafayette Block 483 Lots 38.01/46 (6.23 ac, 8 du/ac, 20% set-aside). Third round unmet need strategies also remain: West Main St (Block 224 multi-lot overlay, 10 AH); Bergen Brick & Tile Block 202 Lot 78.01 (6 AH); Chevrolet Dealership/Block 517 Lot 3.01 + Block 516 Lots 6.03/6.04 (54 AH); Wyckoff Shopping Center Block 235 Lot 3 (5 AH); Abma Farm Block 202 Lot 4 (excess credits); CHCC Evergreen Court 18 excess units.

sources.title: Township of Wyckoff Fourth Round Housing Element and Fair Share Plan (Adopted by Planning Board June 25, 2025)
sources.excerpt: Wyckoff's fourth round obligation (also referred to as the prospective need) is 334. ... The Township's vacant land adjustment for the third round has an RDP of 46. There is no additional RDP ... Review of approvals issued by the Planning Board and Zoning Board, anticipated development and construction permits indicate there is no development activity that generates a fourth round RDP since the Township's third round RDP was last calculated. As such, the Township's RDP remains 46.

sites.site_name: Block 259, Lots 1 & 2 – Franklin Avenue (3rd Round RDP)
sites.mechanism: inclusionary (overlay, mixed-use with ground floor retail + upper residential)
sites.source_page: Pages 17-18 (Satisfaction of the RDP / Block 259, Lots 1, 2 narrative)
sites.quote: Wyckoff addresses a portion of its 46 unit RDP through inclusionary residential development at a density of up to 12 units per acre on Lots 1 and 2 in Block 259. Development of Lots 1 and 2 in Block 259 will also include a first floor retail component, with the residential portion of the development confined to the upper level. At a 15% set-aside for rental affordable units, these two lots would yield approximately 22 total units, of which 3 would be affordable rental units.
sites.notes: Block 259 Lot 2 is a gas station; Lot 1 is the larger adjacent parcel. Together 3.35 acres, 1.85 acres unconstrained (wetlands on portion). RDP contribution = 3 affordable units. Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: Block 216, Lots 17.01, 18, 19 – Greenwood Avenue (3rd Round RDP)
sites.mechanism: inclusionary (overlay, mixed-use apartments + small commercial component)
sites.quote: The Township will address a portion of its 46 unit RDP through the rezoning of Block 216, Lots 17.01, 18 and 19, on Greenwood Avenue. These lots, which are currently in separate ownership, total 23,400 square feet or .537 acres of land, with no environmental constraints. The zoning allows, if assembled, the lots could be developed with apartments at a density of 12 units per acre (perhaps along with a small commercial component), yielding a total of six (6) apartments, of which one (1) would be an affordable rental unit, based on a 15 percent set-aside rate for rental affordable units.
sites.notes: Three separately owned lots, total 23,400 sq ft / 0.537 ac. Owners have inquired about rezoning. RDP contribution = 1 affordable unit. Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: Block 216, Lots 13.08, 13.09, 13.10 – (formerly Lots 12.01 and 13.04) (3rd Round RDP)
sites.address: Wyckoff, NJ (near Boulder Run Shopping Center area)
sites.proposed_zoning: inclusionary overlay, apartments above commercial, ~12-18 units
sites.quote: Wyckoff will address a portion of its 46 unit RDP through the rezoning of Block 216, Lots 13.08, 13.09 and 13.10 (formerly Block 216, Lots 12.01 and 13.04), encompassing a total of 2.39 acres of land. ... It is currently anticipated that the yield would be about 12-18 apartment units, in addition to the ground floor commercial component, thus producing at least two (2) and perhaps as many as three (3) affordable rental units, using the 15 percent set-aside rate for affordable rental units.
sites.notes: Originally 2 lots (12.01 and 13.04), assembled and re-subdivided into 3 single-family lots from 2008 settlement (Boulder Run Shopping Center). Single-family lots remain undeveloped across from Boulder Run. RDP contribution = 2-3 affordable units (plan counts 2 for RDP table). Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: ECCR Group Home – 832 Mountain Avenue (3rd Round RDP)
sites.quote: A five (5) bedroom group home is at 832 Mountain Avenue. It is operated by Eastern Christian Children's Retreat (ECCR), which also operates three (3) other group homes in Wyckoff (that were credited to the Prior Round). Despite its name, all the occupants of the ECCR facilities are aged 18 and over. This group home will yield 5 credits, one for each bedroom. ... Construction is complete.
sites.notes: 5-bedroom special needs group home. Occupants aged 18+. Credits = 5 (one per bedroom). RDP contribution = 5 credits. Block/lot not provided in HEFSP text; address is 832 Mountain Avenue. Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: United Way/Madeline Group Home – Block 238, Lot 2 / 370 Clinton Avenue (3rd Round RDP)
sites.quote: The Township has been working with United Way/Madeline Corporation to fund the establishment of a new six (6) bedroom group home on Block 238, Lot 2, a lot located at 370 Clinton Avenue and owned by the Township of Wyckoff. The development is constructed. The Township receives 6 credits, one for each bedroom, from this development.
sites.notes: 6-bedroom group home on Township-owned land. Credits = 6 (one per bedroom). RDP contribution = 6 credits. Constructed. Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: Maple Lake (Sarna) – Block 320, Lots 10.02, 11 (3rd Round RDP)
sites.mechanism: inclusionary (settlement with intervenor; 60 family apartments + 1 superintendent)
sites.quote: As a result of a settlement with the Intervenor, a portion of the two lots owned by the intervenor (Block 320, Lots 10.02 and 11) will be rezoned to permit the construction of sixty (60) family luxury apartments or condominium units plus one (1) additional unit for the building superintendent. Of the sixty (60) units to be sold or rented, 15% or 9 will be affordable family rental units (2 very low, 3 low and 4 moderate, distributed as evenly as possible among the required bedroom mix of 2 three-bedroom units, 1 one-bedroom unit and 6 two-bedroom units). The balance of the site will be acquired by Wyckoff Township as public open space.
sites.notes: RDP contribution = 9 affordable units + 1 bonus credit (transit, see table) = 10 total credits. Zoned but not yet built. Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: CHCC Evergreen Court (RDP portion – 6 senior rental units) (3rd Round RDP)
sites.address: Christian Health Care Center campus, Wyckoff, NJ
sites.mechanism: affordability control extension (30-year UHAC deed restriction on 24 existing independent living units)
sites.quote: The Township has negotiated with Christian Health Care Center (CHCC) to place new UHAC-compliant 30 year deed restrictions on 24 units of independent living senior citizens housing on which the prior HUD contract has expired. ... Based on a 46 unit RDP, a maximum of 11 of these units could be credited, but the Township will be claiming credit for only 6 age-restricted units to maintain the required ratio of family and non-family (age-restricted and group home) units in its Plan. The remaining units will help to address the Unmet Need.
sites.notes: 24 total units; 6 counted toward RDP (senior cap = 25% of 46 RDP = 11, but only 6 claimed for RDP). Remaining 18 available for unmet need. Exchange for allowing CHCC Vista project (market-rate age-restricted) on campus. Block/lot not specified in HEFSP text. Approved in 3rd round Judgment of Repose.

sites.site_name: Squaw Brook Church – Block 437, Lots 18, 19, 20.02 (4th Round Unmet Need)
sites.mechanism: inclusionary (overlay rezoning for townhouses + limited single-family)
sites.proposed_zoning: inclusionary overlay, 3 du/ac, 20% for-sale / 15% rental set-aside
sites.adoption_status: zoning strategy in adopted 4th round plan; ordinance to be adopted
sites.quote: This 6 ac. (approximately) property along Squaw Brook road is occupied by a vacant church (Block 437, Lots 18, 19, 20.02. The Township will rezone the property to permit townhouses and limited single-family homes at a density of 3 du/ac and an affordable housing set-aside of 20% set-aside for for-sale units and a 15% set-aside for rental units. The site has significant environmental constraints, including wetlands and flood hazard area, which constrain the development potential. The developer contacted the Township for inclusion in this Housing Plan and through those discussions, the ordinance (including the density) has been crafted to accommodate the requested inclusionary development.
sites.notes: Approximately 6 acres. Developer-initiated inclusion in plan. Significant environmental constraints (wetlands/flood hazard). 4th round unmet need strategy. Developer contacted Township seeking amended zoning for inclusionary townhouse development.

sites.proposed_zoning: inclusionary overlay, 4.5 du/ac, 20% for-sale / 15% rental set-aside
sites.adoption_status: zoning strategy in adopted 4th round plan; ordinance to be adopted

sites.notes: Block/lot not specified in HEFSP text; identified by address only. 2.5 ac approx. Wetlands/flood hazard at rear. 4th round unmet need strategy.
